zone.description: The network to a USB host plugged into this Mac in device mode (aurora-usb-gadget). The host is not trusted: it reaches only SSH, mDNS (for hostname.local), DHCP and DNS (for IPV4=shared) and ICMP on this Mac; everything else to this Mac is refused. Forwarded traffic is accepted, so IPV4=shared can share this Mac's connection. Allow more with firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=aurora-usb-gadget --add-service=...
